utilities.Evergy Kansas Central: The 2026 update adds 355 MW of gas in 2029 (Viola), 355 MW in 2030 (McNew) and 710 MW in 2031 (Buchanan Bluffs Unit 1 in Missouri), and no gas through 2035; placeholders 2 to 5 are not in it, and I staged questions on all five and a watch item for Buchanan Bluffs.
utilities.Evergy Metro: The 2026 update adds 440 MW in 2031 (Mullin Creek 2 in Missouri, already in GEM under Missouri), a 355 MW half of a combined cycle in 2032 (Buchanan Bluffs Unit 2 in Missouri) and 440 MW in 2034 or 2035; nothing is new to Kansas and I staged a watch item for Buchanan Bluffs only.
utilities.Kansas City Board of Public Utilities: The 2024 plan commits to no new gas and says no new generation is needed in the next five years. It keeps efficient gas plants as a future option, and one study case adds a 237 MW combustion turbine in 2039. Nothing was staged from it. The plan file gives no date for the next plan, so the tab's Notes should say that.
